name: @tendworks/platform
description: Platform library (not a domain): the Tendworks CloudEvent envelope with W3C trace context, secret references with an allowlist per consumer, Server-Sent Events streams and following a transcript stream, the platform MCP server's name, agent profile and workspace assistant defaults, how clients show costs and run origins, and (under ./migrations, kept out of the browser-safe entry point) versioned schema migrations for one domain's store and a bundle's start-up migration, (under ./secrets-file, also Node.js only) handing one consumer's secrets to another container through a file, (under ./config-documents, Node.js only) reading one kind of document from a configuration folder, (under ./store-connection) the store's connection string with its password, and (under ./workspace-roots, Node.js only) the operator's workspace roots, the check that a directory workspace lies under one and that git credentials go over https only.
